headline: Core MarTech Growth Sustains; H2 Recovery in Focus

highlights: EBITDAM was down 130 bps QoQ but up 236 bps YoY to 20.5% (vs CIE est. of 21.6%) ▪ PAT for Q2FY27 stood at INR 747 Mn, down 21.3% QoQ but up 45.8% YoY (vs CIE est. of INR 913 Mn), due to low other income Steady MarTech Expansion; Diversified Growth Drives H2 Outlook: RATEGAIN reported Q2FY27 revenue of INR 7,454 Mn, up 153% YoY, largely reflecting Sojern consolidation, while organic growth stood at 14%.
Properties and Destinations sustained over 20% organic growth in H1FY27, together contributing to over 80% of MarTech revenue, while Corporate (~15% of MarTech) remained subdued, declining ~14%.
DAAS grew 7% YoY in Q2, taking H1 growth to 14%, led by traction across Air, OTA and Car.

We expect H2 growth to strengthen, driven by Corporate stabilisation, seasonal recovery in Destinations and sustained cross-selling, supporting the management's revenue guidance of INR 30,000–31,000 Mn.
valuation: The management retained FY27 guidance, targeting revenue at the upper end of INR 30,000– 31,000 Mn and Adjusted EBITDAM of 22.5–23.5%.
View & Valuation: We remain constructive on RATEGAIN’s medium-term outlook, supported by core Martech growth, cross-selling synergies & expanding platform monetisation.
